leaves.name: x6CoarseModuliIdeal
leaves.doc: x6-coarse, printed form of x6CoarseModuli: the canonical model X6 = X0(6,1) over Q is a proper smooth curve and a coarse moduli scheme for abelian surfaces with QM by O: a bijection Psi on Qbar-points with QM pairs up to isomorphism, natural for Spec sigma, sigma in Aut(Qbar/Q) (X6ALIdeal.GaloisNatural: if Q is a base change of P along sigma, Psi(Spec sigma . x) = [Q]; Mumford GIT Def. 5.6), the Atkin-Lehner clause in the printed ideal-quotient form (for each m | 6 an automorphism w_m of X over Q sends [(A, iota)] to [(A/A[I_m], iota_m)], I_m = {a in O : m | nrd a} the two-sided ideal of reduced norm m, read as every O-equivariant isogeny with scheme-theoretic kernel A[I_m]; X6ALIdeal.ALIdealClause; Rotger, Trans. AMS 356 (2004)), and the classifying map of a level-3 QM abelian scheme over a proper smooth curve. Implies x6CoarseModuli with no hypothesis (X6ALIdeal.x6CoarseModuli_of_ideal: I_m = O mu_m and iota(mu_m) is such an isogeny onto (A, iota o Ad mu_m); the Galois clause is galoisClause_iff_natural); equivalent to it given the textbook fields gagaMorphism and mumfordTorsionAlgClosed (X6ALIdeal.x6CoarseModuliIdeal_iff; the quotient of A by A[I_m] is (A, iota o Ad mu_m) by X6ALIdeal.iso_of_quotient_lat, through the lattice model). Locators UNVERIFIED (Shimura 1967; Deligne, Sem. Bourbaki 389; Buzzard, Duke 87 (1997) section 1).
